title: This Quiz Gets Harder Every Question
script:
How high can you score?
Question 1: Which actor is famous for playing Iron Man in the Marvel Cinematic Universe?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is B: Robert Downey Jr..
Question 2: Which continent is home to the vast Amazon Rainforest?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is C: South America.
Question 3: Who was the first human to step on the Moon?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is C: Neil Armstrong.
If you got the first three right, like the video right now.
Question 4: What is the largest ocean on Earth by surface area and volume?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is D: Pacific Ocean.
Question 5: Which film won the very first Academy Award for Best Picture in 1929?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is C: Wings.
Score check: comment SHARP if you are still perfect, RUSTY if you already missed one.
Question 6: Mount Everest, the world's highest peak, is located in which mountain range?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is D: Himalayas.
Question 7: In what year did the RMS Titanic sink after hitting an iceberg?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is B: 1912.
Are you ready for the last question?
Don't forget to follow and comment your score to be on the weekly leaderboard of the top performers.
Question 8: What is the only mammal capable of true, sustained flight?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is C: Bat.
Question 9: Which country invented tea?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is D: China.
Bonus: double or nothing - keep your score in your head and beat it on the next quiz.
Comment your score out of 9, and follow for a new quiz every day.

items.question: Which actor is famous for playing Iron Man in the Marvel Cinematic Universe?
items.explanation: Robert Downey Jr. played Tony Stark, also known as Iron Man, across many MCU films.

items.question: Which continent is home to the vast Amazon Rainforest?
items.explanation: The Amazon Rainforest covers a large area of South America, primarily Brazil.

items.question: Who was the first human to step on the Moon?
items.explanation: Neil Armstrong made history on July 20, 1969, as he stepped onto the lunar surface.

items.question: What is the largest ocean on Earth by surface area and volume?
items.explanation: The Pacific Ocean covers about one-third of the surface of the Earth.

items.question: Which film won the very first Academy Award for Best Picture in 1929?
items.explanation: "Wings" was a silent film about World War I aviators and won the first Best Picture Oscar.

items.question: Mount Everest, the world's highest peak, is located in which mountain range?
items.explanation: Mount Everest is part of the Himalayan range, bordering Nepal and China.

items.question: In what year did the RMS Titanic sink after hitting an iceberg?
items.explanation: The Titanic sank on its maiden voyage in April 1912, resulting in a tragic loss of life.

items.question: What is the only mammal capable of true, sustained flight?
items.explanation: Bats are the only mammals that can truly fly, using their wings to generate lift.

items.question: Which country invented tea?
items.explanation: Tea was first brewed in ancient China.
